Title: Shadow Court Satyr + Weighted Walking Stick

Messages.Author: Ankur Gupta
Messages.Body:
Ok, so I'm part of a degenerate playgroup that decided to use a Shadow
Court Satyr and throw a Weighted Walking Stick on it. Now, the question is
whether the WWS burns once its counters run out. The answer to this is
yes. I found that in a ruling by LSJ from 2002.

Here's the question though:

Suppose the WWS has 3 counters on it. It's still on the SCS. At this
point, could you elect to employ the SCS text and "use the ability of that
card as if that card had been played from your hand"? The SCS is careful
not to suggest that "that card" is still a combat card. So, it could in
fact be a piece of equipment.

This would of course mean that a SCS would always be able to play with the
Weighted Walking Stick for the rest of the game. Why for the love of god,
you wouldn't play with Lucky Blow instead, I don't know.

Anyway, any answers would be welcome.

Thanks,

Ankur Gupta
Prince of West Lafayette
"Weighted Walking Sticks are not good for corn."

Hello,

a few assumptions:

Card text (Weighted Walking Stick) says that a minion may have only one
WWS. The problem with playing it "as from your hand" with SCS's ability
is that you can't play it - SCS already has one. When all WWS counters
are used up, there seems to be no window to play the same WWS again on
SCS. I'm pretty sure that WWS card text was written with this
particular situation in mind :)

This actually brings up a question about Zip Gun - can you repeat the
"equip from your hand" -part every combat with Shadow Court Satyr that
has one (originally)? ). Zip Gun does not have the "Minion can have
only one" restriction. I did a brief search on the Newsgroup but there
seemed to nothing about this issue (although there was thread about ZG
+ SCS). Quite cornercase, but anyway...

Heikki Parviainen
